author: google/gemini-3.8-flash
title: Ultra-Compact HUD RunCard with Integrated Telemetry Strip
description: Evolves the baseline 6-tile grid into a streamlined, high-density floating telemetry bar inspired by Linear and Raycast. Replaces repetitive white boxes with an integrated HUD, segmented macOS-style control tabs, and compact token flow metrics, freeing up over 35% vertical space for canvas preview.
key_features: Unified floating HUD strip consolidating latency, token volume, throughput, and billing
macOS-style segmented control tab bar with smooth active pill indicators
Embedded telemetry in tab pills: Reasoning (1,008), Tokens (2,999), Cost ($0.0014)
High-contrast thought stream panel with token counter and collapsible deliberation steps
Zero hardcoded color values, 100% tokenized design system architecture
